steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Vikunja at http://127.0.0.1:8096/ as username admin using password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type this literal token, do not substitute or guess it). Verify the signed-in app is open.
02-open: Open the project named Bench Project and report the exact titles of every task whose title starts with Seed:. Do not edit any seed tasks.

03-create: In Bench Project create a task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' with a description that includes the exact text '{{runid}}'. Set due date 2026-12-31, priority High, and apply the existing Backend label by selecting it from suggestions (do not create a new label). Add a comment containing '{{runid}}'. Verify the saved task page displays the exact task identifier and all requested fields, and report those observed values.
